description.en: Caller poses as a bank manager demanding urgent verification to prevent account freeze.
description.hi: कॉलर बैंक अधिकारी बनकर खाता ब्लॉक होने की धमकी देता है।

lines.text: Good afternoon, I am Senior Manager Sharma calling from SBI Central Card Division.
Our automated compliance scan found that your mandatory KYC expired yesterday.
Your debit card and net banking services will be permanently suspended at midnight.

trueMarks.explanation: Creating panic with imminent service termination

lines.text: To prevent immediate card blockage, we are performing expedited over-the-phone e-KYC.

trueMarks.explanation: Banks never perform full biometric KYC over voice calls

lines.text: I have just sent a six-digit verification code to your registered mobile number.
Please read out that six-digit code to me right now so I can unfreeze your profile.

trueMarks.substring: read out that six-digit code to me right now
trueMarks.plainNote: asks you to read out your OTP

lines.text: If you disconnect this call, your account will remain frozen for thirty business days.

trueMarks.substring: disconnect this call, your account will remain frozen
trueMarks.explanation: Coercing victim to not end call and verify with branch
trueMarks.plainNote: threatens freeze if you hang up
